qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant liquidity network effects in OTC rates, FX, and energy markets alongside Parameta Solutions' proprietary OTC benchmark pricing data. However, returns are heavily constrained by voice-broker compensation pools and structural commission compression.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). TP ICAP is the world's leading interdealer broker, but its core voice and hybrid broking franchises face severe secular terminal headwinds from financial market electronification, algorithmic cross-matching, and automated swap execution platforms.
qualitative.evidence: Adjusted EBIT margins in traditional Global Broking are thin (high single digits to mid teens) due to broker compensation structures. While Parameta Solutions provides high-margin (35-42%) OTC pricing data, over 70% of group revenue remains exposed to structurally declining voice/hybrid broking and cyclical trading volatility.
